token.name: Streaming AMM LP (SALP), the Pool's LP share token

contracts.name: Pool
contracts.role: constant-product pool (30 bps fee), TWAP accumulator, and the SALP LP-share ERC-20

contracts.name: OrderBook
contracts.role: ERC-721 streaming orders (SORDER): holds the unsold balance, runs equal slices, pays the NFT holder

contracts.name: PriceGuard
contracts.role: Chainlink BTC/USD check (staleness, sign, round) and pool-vs-oracle deviation band; owner can change only two capped numbers

contracts.name: MockWBTC
contracts.role: test WBTC (8 decimals) with a capped faucet

contracts.name: MockUSDC
contracts.role: test USDC (6 decimals) with a capped faucet

features.feature: Chainlink price check (staleness, sign, round) used as a guard before each slice
TWAP oracle from the pool's own price accumulator
Off-chain keeper script that calls executeSlice (no double-send, logs tx hash)
Arbitrage bot that refills the pool between slices
Test suite with one command (yarn test, 92 passing) including revert, reentrancy and invariant tests
Slither scan with each finding fixed or explained
Gas measured with before-and-after changes (pool storage packing, 2-slot order storage)
features.evidence: docs/gas-pool.md, docs/gas-orders.md; measured Sepolia gas in docs/data/evidence_sepolia.json

features.feature: Front end: wallet, pool and oracle view, impact preview, confirmation step, order progress, claim and cancel, stale-feed warning, plain-language errors
Financial analysis reconciled with Sepolia: model equals on-chain output for 3 of 3 slices; streamed order +66 bps over a lump sum
